dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, bright-white boundary edges against dark-gray feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition where the smooth, uniform brownish-gray texture of the crown meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme 'scalloped' effect across all dorsal feathers caused by wide, high-contrast pale fringes on dark feather bodies.
